en: Early 20th‑century black‑and‑white postcard with a panoramic view of the town of Tolmin and its surrounding fields and hills; a church spire is prominent. Caption reads "Pozdrav iz Tolmina." Publisher credit is printed along the left edge. Handwritten message is on the image front. The back shows an address written in Slovene to Anton Mervic in Povirje pri Sežani, with an Austro‑Hungarian 5‑heller stamp and circular postmarks.
